text:
# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host1, AnduinOS 2.0.5, UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-14T01:58:14Z
#
# Disks:
#   vda (25 GiB) -> /dev/sdq
#
# Notes:
#   - AnduinOS: shim, MokManager and AnduinOS's GRUB, signed with the MOK /var/lib/shim-signed/mok/MOK.der (SHA-256 b39746963dd168d04d4fc5ed5dfb42fb656f1725d621c12de44ebb8ed1f7e3a4), are the restored ESP's; grub-install --target=x86_64-efi isn't run (AnduinOS's is plain GRUB and would write an unsigned image), only grub.cfg is remade.  On the same machine its firmware holds the key; on other hardware with Secure Boot on, enroll it again (`mokutil --import /var/lib/shim-signed/mok/MOK.der`, then confirm it at MokManager on the next boot) or turn Secure Boot off
#   - AnduinOS: the Disk Snapshots Manager's records name each snapshot by its Btrfs subvolume UUID, which a restore can't keep (the subvolumes are made anew), so its snapshot list and Factory Reset may need re-pointing at the restored snapshots

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6144 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2101248 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2103296 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6295552 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda4: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6297600 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=52424704 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 34
last-lba: 52428766

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=4096, type=21686148-6449-6E6F-744E-656564454649, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002, name="label-1"
/dev/sdq2 : start=6144, size=2097152, type=C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, name="efi-system"
/dev/sdq3 : start=2103296, size=4194304, type=0657FD6D-A4AB-43C4-84E5-0933C84B4F4F, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004, name="swap"
/dev/sdq4 : start=6297600, size=46129152, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006, name="root"
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
# (nothing to do)

# ---- format ----
# vda2: vfat "LABEL2"
mkfs.fat -F 32 -i BC000001 -n LABEL2 -S 512 -s 8 -f 2 -R 32 -h 6144 -M 0xf8 /dev/sdq2
# check: /dev/sdq2 is vfat with the source's FAT size, sector and cluster size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda3: swap "label-3"
mkswap -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005 -L label-3 --pagesize 4096 /dev/sdq3
# check: /dev/sdq3 is swap with the source's UUID, label and page size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda4: btrfs "AnduinOS"
mkfs.btrfs -f -O extref,skinny-metadata,no-holes,^raid56,^raid1c34,^zoned,^squota,free-space-tree,^block-group-tree -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007 -L AnduinOS --csum crc32c -n 16384 -s 4096 -d single -m dup --device-uuid bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008 /dev/sdq4
# check: /dev/sdq4 is btrfs with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# GRUB's environment block in btrfs's reserved area (grubenv's env_block=512+1), as the source's: mkfs.btrfs zeroed it
dd of=/dev/sdq4 bs=512 seek=512 count=1 iflag=fullblock conv=notrunc,fsync status=none <<'EOF'
# GRUB Environment Block
#######################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################################
EOF
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007
# btrfs bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007: its subvolumes
mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 /dev/sdq4 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007/@root
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007/@home
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007/@log
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007/@snapshots
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007/@containers
btrfs subvolume create /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007/@libvirt
umount /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007

# ---- mount ----
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@root,compress=zstd:3,noatime /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/.snapshots
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@snapshots,compress=zstd:3,noatime /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target/.snapshots
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/home
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@home,compress=zstd:3,noatime /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target/home
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
mount -t vfat -o noatime /dev/sdq2 /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/var/log
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@log,compress=zstd:3,noatime /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target/var/log
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/var/lib/containers
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@containers,compress=zstd:3,noatime /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target/var/lib/containers
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/var/lib/libvirt/images
mount -t btrfs -o subvol=@libvirt,compress=zstd:3,noatime /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target/var/lib/libvirt/images

# ---- restore ----
mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt
# the archiver's restore --exact, for the btrfs snapshots and aliases
sh -c 'rustic-bko restore --help > /run/bko-holt/restore.help 2>&1; grep -q -- '\''--exact'\'' /run/bko-holt/restore.help || { echo "rustic-bko has no restore --exact, which this layout'\''s btrfs needs: use rustic-bko 0.11.4+backotter.11 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }'
# left out of the restore: btrfs subvolumes mounted elsewhere, seen again (aliases), and the contents of the shared snapshots, made after it
cat > /run/bko-holt/restore.globs <<'EOF'
!/.snapshots/anduinos-btrfs-snapshots-manager/deployments/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011/root/**
!/.snapshots/anduinos-btrfs-snapshots-manager/personal/snapshots/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013/home/**
EOF
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id --glob-file /run/bko-holt/restore.globs latest /mnt/bko-target
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007
# btrfs bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007: its shared snapshots (noatime: reading them changes nothing)
mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5,noatime /dev/sdq4 /run/bko-holt/btrfs/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007
# @snapshots/anduinos-btrfs-snapshots-manager/deployments/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011/root: a snapshot of @root, then made exact from the backup's /.snapshots/anduinos-btrfs-snapshots-manager/deployments/bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011/root (ID 262, as on the source)
